fns.desc: hostapd_global_ctrl_iface_init (UDP variant): getaddrinfo() result (saveres) is only freed via freeaddrinfo(saveres) on the success path (line 5940). The fail: label (lines 5955-5958, reached if socket() fails at 5925 or bind() exhausts its retry limit at 5936-5937) returns -1 without ever calling freeaddrinfo(saveres) -- a genuine addrinfo-list memory leak on those error paths.
